lead: Shah Rukh Khan is an Indian television presenter, born on 2 November 1965 in New Delhi.
As of 2026, he is 60 years old, and his birth date places him under the Scorpio sign.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has held the office of UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador.
The sections that follow break down Shah Rukh Khan's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Shah Rukh Khan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Shah Rukh Khan was born on 2 November 1965 in New Delhi, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Taj Mohammed Khan and his mother, Lateef Fatima. He is a sibling of Shehnaz Lalarukh Khan.
He studied at National School of Drama, Jamia Millia Islamia and University of Delhi.

sections.heading: Shah Rukh Khan — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists television presenter, screenwriter, film producer, dancer and film actor as his occupations.
He has held the following offices: UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador (2013–present).
